p: holy oracle: He counts himself as a dead man, till God shows his favour toward him, and grants him his petition.
Draw me not away with the: Destroy not the good with the bad.
Give them according to their deeds: He thus prayed in respect to God's glory and not for his own cause, being assured that God would punish the persecutors of his Church.
destroy them: Let them be utterly destroyed as in Mal 1:4.
Blessed be the LORD: Because he felt the assurance of God's help in his heart, his mouth was opened to sing his praises.
their strength: Meaning his soldiers who were means by which God declared his power.
